description: This file contains a unit test class for testing the authentication endpoint of the Public API in the eShopOnWeb project. It uses MSTest framework to define parameterized tests that verify login credentials behavior.

classes.name: AuthenticateEndpoint
classes.description: A test class containing methods to verify the behavior of the authentication API endpoint with different credentials.

methods.name: ReturnsExpectedResultGivenCredentials
methods.description: A parameterized test method that sends an authentication request with provided credentials and asserts the expected result.
